title: Concept: External program launched through NSTask in objc — review required
description: In objc, a task object is created to run a program. macOS grants the application the user identity, so an attacker who controls the launch path or the arguments can execute code without a further exploit. Documents and URL schemes are the usual delivery channels.
applicability: objc macOS applications that shell out to helpers.
risk: Arbitrary program execution with the user identity; HIGH severity.
